critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 3281 lines. Report endpoints (10 handlers) added directly in main file - recommend splitting into /routers/reports.py alongside the previously suggested marketing/price-tracking/auth routers.

Report GET endpoints have no caching. Each request re-hits Google Ads/GA4/GSC APIs (3-5s latency). Consider a short TTL in-memory cache (e.g., 5 min) keyed by (endpoint, date_from, date_to) to avoid quota pressure and improve UX.

POST /api/reports/ai-report and the 8 GET /api/reports/* endpoints do not have Pydantic request/response models. Adding response_model would give OpenAPI docs and validate the Google API response shape.
All /api/reports/* endpoints accept date_from/date_to as raw strings with no format validation - malformed dates would surface as opaque Google API errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 tabs + sidebar nav verified with real data)
